overview: This tiny module measures distance by literally timing a pulse of laser light's round trip (time-of-flight), giving millimeter-level accuracy in a package smaller than a fingernail — a completely different measurement principle from the HC-SR04's sound echo or the Sharp sensor's triangulation. It talks over I2C rather than returning a raw analog voltage or timed pulse, which makes readings simpler to work with but introduces a classic multi-sensor gotcha: every VL53L0X ships with the same default I2C address, so wiring up more than one on the same bus requires using each sensor's XSHUT pin to bring them up one at a time and assign each a unique address in software.
simpleSummary: A tiny sensor that measures distance by timing a laser pulse's round trip.

specifications.operatingVoltage: 2.6V - 5.5V (module has onboard regulator; raw sensor die is 2.8V)
specifications.measuringRange: VL53L0X: up to ~2m; VL53L1X: up to ~4m
specifications.measurementSpeed: Up to ~50Hz depending on configured accuracy/range mode

pinMap.name: VIN
pinMap.function: Power input to the module's onboard regulator.

pinMap.name: SDA
pinMap.voltageRange: 0-3.3V (module usually includes level shifting for 5V systems)

pinMap.name: GPIO1
pinMap.function: Configurable interrupt output — can signal 'new measurement ready' without polling over I2C.

pinMap.name: XSHUT
pinMap.function: Active-LOW shutdown pin — pulling it LOW puts the sensor in hardware standby with the I2C bus released.
pinMap.gotcha: The key to running multiple VL53L0X sensors on one I2C bus: hold all but one in shutdown via XSHUT, assign the active one a new address, then bring up the next one — done once at startup.

useCases.title: Precision short-range obstacle detection
useCases.scenario: Far more accurate than ultrasonic for close-range robot navigation or gesture sensing.

useCases.title: Multi-sensor array for wide-angle sensing
useCases.scenario: Several VL53L0X units around a robot's perimeter, each brought up individually via XSHUT to get a unique I2C address.

useCases.title: Liquid level sensing (non-contact)
useCases.scenario: Mounted facing down into a tank for precise, contactless level measurement.

oftenUpgradedTo: RPLIDAR (for full 360° scanning instead of single-point distance)
